checkout.title: Kwishyura
checkout.waiting: Reba telefoni yawe wemeze ubusabe bwo kwishyura kuri mobile money. Uru rupapuro ruzahita rwivugurura...
checkout.hasSubscription: Ufite ifatabuguzi rikora — tangaza iri tangazo ku buntu.
checkout.hasCredit: Ufite amanota yo kumenyekanisha — yakoreshe utangaze iri tangazo ku buntu:
checkout.payPerListingDetail: Ritangazwa ako kanya, hiyongereyeho amasaha 24 ku isonga.

checkout.howItWorks: Uko kwishyura na mobile money bikorwa
checkout.step1: Hitamo gahunda yawe wandike numero ya telefone ifitanye isano na konti yawe ya mobile money.
checkout.step2: Uzabona ubutumwa bwo kwishyura kuri iyo telefone — andika PIN yawe kugira ngo wemeze.
checkout.step3: Itangazo ryawe rijya ku rubuga byikoresha nyuma yo kwemeza kwishyura.
checkout.securePayment: Kwishyura bikorwa mu buryo bwizewe na PawaPay. Ntabwo tubona cyangwa tubika PIN yawe.

home.heroTitle: Akazi, amasoko, cyamunara n'ibyamamazwa — u Rwanda rwose ahantu hamwe
home.heroSubtitle: Tangaza mu minota mike, wishyure na mobile money, ugere ku baguzi n'abashaka akazi mu gihugu hose.
home.heroBadge: Amasoko ya Leta, avugururwa buri munsi ava kuri Umucyo
home.searchPlaceholder: Shakisha akazi, amasoko, cyamunara cyangwa ibyamamazwa...
home.trustTenders: Aturuka ku rubuga rwa Umucyo rw'u Rwanda
home.trustSecure: Ishyura na MTN MoMo cyangwa Airtel Money
home.newsletterDescription: Jya wakira amatangazo mashya y'akazi, amasoko na cyamunara kuri imeyili yawe.
home.howItWorksSubtitle: Intambwe eshatu zikugeza ku kazi, ku isoko cyangwa ku masezerano.
home.step1Desc: Shakisha akazi, amasoko ya Leta, cyamunara n'ibyamamazwa byo mu Rwanda hose — amatangazo mashya buri munsi.
home.step2Desc: Saba cyangwa uvugane n'ugurisha uhereye ku itangazo — amatariki ntarengwa, inyandiko n'amakuru yo kuvugana biri aho.
home.step3Desc: Vugana n'umukoresha cyangwa ugurisha musoze — ubufasha buri kuri WhatsApp.
home.posterTitle: Uragurisha, urashaka abakozi, cyangwa utanga isoko?
home.posterText: Tangaza mu minota mike ugere ku baguzi n'abashaka akazi mu Rwanda hose. 10.000 RWF bitangaza itangazo ryawe hamwe n'amasaha 24 ari ku rutonde rw'ibyihariye kuri iyi paji — wishyure na MTN MoMo cyangwa Airtel Money.
home.pricingSubtitle: Ishyura buri tangazo, cyangwa wiyandikishe umwaka wose utangaze uko ubishaka.
home.packageAnnualNote: Umwaka wose wo gutangaza, hamwe na boosts
home.packageBoostNote: Igiciro cy'abiyandikishije — shyira itangazo mu y'ibanze
